mainImage.alt: Five Bedouin children outside their home in Khan al-Ahmar village in the occupied West Bank
mainImage.caption: Five young Bedouin children in Khan al-Ahmar, the West Bank village facing imminent demolition ordered by Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich.

body.alt: Israeli bulldozer operating near Khan al-Ahmar Bedouin village in the occupied West Bank
body.caption: An Israeli bulldozer works near Khan al-Ahmar, the Bedouin village Israel has repeatedly targeted for demolition. The E1 corridor settlement project would sever the West Bank in two. Credit: Reuters via The Independent

body.alt: Palestinian man walking with flag through Khan al-Ahmar Bedouin village in the occupied West Bank
body.caption: A Palestinian of the Jahalin Bedouin tribe walks with a Palestinian flag in Khan al-Ahmar, the Israeli-occupied West Bank village that Smotrich ordered destroyed in retaliation for an ICC arrest warrant. Credit: AFP via Middle East Eye
